title: app-shell: a list-route URL form that carries a filter the list view applies, so a chat answer can link "open the matching list"
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: ② a class (a) out-of-scope finding from a cloud card's os-dev-report: cloud#4079 report 6735520788, F2. The cloud half is PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4087, whose `source` block leaves `link` out until this exists.

Dedupe: no open issue names a filter URL param on list views or a filtered deep link.

Suggested grade: p3. Reader: a `domain:ui` seat.

## Problem

No list URL applies a filter. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:654` reads one URL param, `view`. The app-shell list views read no filter or where param; the other params are `recordId`, `q` on `SearchResultsPage.tsx:77`, and context selectors. The chat's link grammar (objectui `RECORD_LINK_PATTERN`) opens only `/record/OBJECT/ID`. So an Ask answer that says "12 open opportunities" cannot link to those 12. Reach: read from the route at framework pin `9e1f1f90`, not exercised in a live browser.

## What done looks like

1. A list-route URL form that carries a filter, for example an encoded `filter` param in the same filter shape the data API accepts. The list view applies it on top of the chosen view and shows it as a removable filter chip.
2. The filter goes through the same permission checks as a filter typed in the UI. A filter on a field the viewer cannot read is refused and the list opens unfiltered, with a notice; it is never silently dropped to show more.
3. The chat's link grammar admits this list form beside the record form.
4. Tests:
   - a URL with a filter opens the list filtered;
   - a filter on a hidden field is refused with the notice;
   - an unknown param is ignored;
   - a chat answer link of the list form is clickable.

Seam: cloud `source.filter` → app-shell ObjectView list route. When this lands, cloud adds `source.link` (a follow-up there).
